chat.title: Try it: chat with {shop}
chat.demo_note: This chat runs the same agent as the shop's WhatsApp.
dashboard.title: Dashboard
receipt.title: Check a receipt
trust.title: Trust page
agent.fallback: Sorry, I could not answer right now. The shop owner will reply soon.
home.demo_note: These shops and their customers are made up for the demo.
chat.empty: Say salam to start. The shop's assistant answers in the language you write in.
dashboard.lede: Orders, payments waiting for approval, books and fraud alerts will be here for the shop owner.
receipt.lede: Every Chatfront receipt carries a QR code. Scanning it opens this page and shows whether the receipt is genuine.
trust.lede: Only the channels listed here belong to {shop}. Anyone else using its name is not the shop.
trust.channels: Official ways to reach the shop
link.whatsapp_greeting: Salam {shop}! I found your shop on Chatfront.
landing.title: A whole shop inside the chats your customers already use.
landing.lede: Chatfront answers customers on WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger in the language they write in, takes the order, and checks every payment screenshot against the money that really arrived.
demo.ask: How much is this lawn suit?
demo.price: Rs 4,850 for the 3-piece. Bank transfer or cash on delivery?
proof.title: A fake screenshot cannot pass.
proof.lede: Chatfront reads the screenshot, then looks for the credit SMS on the shop's own phone. An order is marked paid only when the amount, the transaction ID and the time all agree.
proof.verdict: All three match: the order is marked paid and a signed receipt goes out. If anything differs, the owner gets Approve and Reject buttons with the evidence.
how.title: How a shop runs on Chatfront
how.1_title: Send a photo and a voice note
how.1_body: The product lands in the catalog with its name, price, sizes and description.
how.2_title: The agent sells in every chat
how.2_body: On WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger, in each customer's own language, and never below the owner's lowest price.
how.3_body: Payments are matched to the bank SMS, receipts are signed, and every sale lands in the books.
chat.suggest_4: Do you take cash on delivery?
chat.queued: Sends when the server is awake
wake.note: Free hosting sleeps when idle. The page works meanwhile.
lang.note: Beta: not yet tested with live models. Translations are waiting for a native speaker's review.
owner.help: I'm your shop's assistant. To add a product, send its photo, then its name and price in a voice note or in writing. To change a price or a shop policy, just tell me, for example: "lawn 3-piece is now 2,500".
owner.photo_received: Got the photo. Now tell me its name and price, in a voice note or in writing.
owner.need_price: What is the price? Write it like this: Lawn suit 4850
owner.voice_unclear: I couldn't make out the voice note. Please write the name and price instead.
owner.in_stock: {count, plural, one {# in stock} other {# in stock}}
owner.product_added: Added {name} (code {code}). It is on your shop page now: {link}
owner.expired: That request has expired. Please send it again.
owner.changes_applied: {count, plural, one {Done: # change saved.} other {Done: # changes saved.}}
owner.not_found: I couldn't find "{name}" among your products.
owner.which: Which one do you mean: {options}? Send the change again with the product's code.
owner.need_amount: What should the new price of {name} be?
owner.floor_above_price: The lowest price for {name} can't be above its price.
start.welcome: Assalam-o-alaikum! Let's make your shop in a few minutes. What is your shop called, and what do you sell?
start.ask_type: What kind of business is it?
start.ask_city: Which city do you sell from?
start.ask_delivery: Where do you deliver, and how long does it take?
start.ask_payment: How do customers pay you? JazzCash, Easypaisa, bank transfer, Raast or cash on delivery?
start.ask_products: Now send a photo of a product, with its name and price. Send as many as you like, then write "done". You can also write "done" now and add products later.
start.product_noted: Noted: {name}, {price}. Send the next one, or write "done".
start.made:
Your shop is ready: {link}
Manage it here (keep this link private): {owner_link}
start.trial_note: Because it was made on the website, this shop is kept for 7 days.
start.cancelled: Okay, I've stopped. Say hello whenever you want to start again.
chat.mic_blocked: The microphone is blocked. Allow it for this site to send voice notes.
chat.no_recording: This browser can't record voice notes. Type instead, or send a photo.
chat.not_sent_type: Not sent: only photos and voice notes can be sent here.
chat.not_sent_size: Not sent: the file is larger than 20 MB.
catalog.empty: No products here yet. Ask in the chat what is available.
shop.try_owner_title: Own a shop like this? Run it for three days
shop.try_owner_body: Get your own copy and use it as the owner: add a product from a photo, change a price with a voice note, set delivery times. Your copy is deleted after three days.
shop.try_owner_failed: Your copy couldn't be made. Try again in a minute.
make.title: Make your shop by chatting
make.lede: Answer a few questions, send photos of what you sell, and your shop page is ready in about five minutes. The same chat works on WhatsApp.
make.note: Chatfront's own assistant makes your shop. Nothing is made until you confirm the summary.
make.suggest_1: Salam! I want to make a shop.
console.title: Owner console
console.demo_note: This is your own copy of a demo shop, for trying things out. It is deleted after three days.
console.chat_note: Send a product photo with its name and price to add it. Write or say a change, like "delivery takes 2 days in Lahore". Nothing changes until you tap the button.
console.chat_empty: Send a photo, or tell the assistant what to change.
console.suggest_2: Delivery takes 2 to 3 days across Pakistan
console.suggest_3: The shop is open every day, 11am to 10pm
console.no_products: No products yet. Send a photo with its name and price in the chat.
console.by_model: Written by the assistant. Correct it if needed.
console.name: Name
console.expired: This session has ended. Open the link from your shop again.
console.signed_out_body: The console opens from the private link you got when your shop was made. No shop yet? Make one by chatting, or try a demo shop as its owner.
order.delivery_tbc: Delivery to {city}: the shop will confirm the charge
order.placed_cod: Order {code} is placed. You pay {total} in cash when it arrives. We will tell you when it is on its way.
order.unique_note: ({off} is taken off, so your payment is easy to recognise.)
order.account_later: The shop will send its account details here.
order.pay_cod_advance: Payment: cash on delivery, with an advance of about {advance} by transfer to confirm the order
order.kept: Okay, nothing has changed. Tell me what you would like to do.
order.cart_changed: Your cart changed after that summary, so it was not placed. Tell me when you are ready and I will send a fresh one.
order.out_of_stock: Sorry, only {count} of {name} are left, so the order was not placed. Tell me what to change.
order.cancel_confirm: Cancel order {code} ({total})? The items go back on sale.
order.too_late: This order can no longer be changed here.
order.handed_over: I have asked the shop owner to reply to you here. They usually answer soon.
handover.count: {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} in this chat
handover.back: The shop's assistant is back with you. How can I help?
handover.resumed: The assistant has the chat again.
console.reply_placeholder: Write to the customer in your own language
payment.checking: Thank you, I have your payment screenshot for order {code}. I will confirm here as soon as the money shows up in the shop's account.
payment.with_owner: Thank you, I have your payment screenshot for order {code}. The shop will check it and confirm here.
payment.already: I already have this screenshot for order {code}, and it is being checked.
payment.received_full: Payment received: {amount} for order {code}. It is paid in full, and the shop will pack it now.
payment.received_part: Payment received: {amount} for order {code}. Still to pay: {balance}.
payment.received_advance: Advance received: {amount}. Order {code} is confirmed; you pay {rest} in cash when it arrives.
payment.not_confirmed: The shop could not confirm the payment for order {code}. Please check the transfer and send the screenshot again, or write here to talk to the shop.
payment.reminder: Order {code} is still waiting for your payment of {due}. Once you have paid, send the screenshot here. To change or cancel the order, just tell me.
payment.sms_match: SMS on your phone: {amount} arrived, transaction {tid}
payment.no_sms: No SMS for this money has reached Chatfront.
payment.signal.not_successful: The screenshot does not show a completed transfer.
payment.signal.amount_differs: The amount is not the amount asked for.
payment.signal.amount_unreadable: The amount could not be read.
payment.signal.paid_before_order: It was paid before the order was placed.
payment.signal.time_in_future: Its time is later than now.
payment.signal.reused_here: The same screenshot was sent for another order.
payment.signal.reused_elsewhere: The same screenshot was sent to another shop.
payment.signal.unverified_parser: The SMS matches, but the SMS reader for this wallet has not been checked on a real message yet.
payment.signal.unread: The picture could not be read automatically.
payment.signal.no_forwarder: SMS forwarding is not set up, so only you can confirm that the money arrived.
payment.approved: Approved. Order {code} is updated, and the customer has the receipt.
payment.rejected: Rejected. The customer was asked to check the payment for order {code}.
payment.decided_before: This payment has already been decided.
console.payments_none: Nothing to check. Payments that need you appear here.
console.sms_on: On. Wallet and bank SMS from your phone are matched to orders.
console.sms_off: Off. Every payment waits for your Approve.
console.sms_steps: Install a free SMS forwarder app on your Android phone and have it send wallet and bank SMS to this link. Copy it now: it is shown only once, and a new link stops the old one.
receipt.valid: Signature checked: this receipt was issued by {shop} and has not been changed.
receipt.invalid: The signature does not match. Do not trust this receipt.
receipt.server_checked: Checked by the Chatfront server, because this browser cannot check signatures itself.
receipt.not_found: There is no receipt with this code.
